- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-003 published (fols. 4r–5r; 37 units; 133 new glossary forms, 9 entries broadened: quech, que, chi, ca, quix, vi, ꜭoh, chic, vꜭhaxic). The day-keepers Xpiyacoc and Xmucane cast lots with maize and tz'ite'; the people of wood are made, multiply, but do not remember their makers, and are destroyed by the flood and by Xecotcovach, Camalotz, Cotzbalam and Tucumbalam. Review: pass 1 — 0 major, 8 minor, 3 style (Que ꜭhau ongoing not completive; ma ca hizah parse; ieioh mt → yeyoj; drafter's p fields removed, the build sets them); pass 2 — 0 major, 8 minor, 9 style (Brasseur's ch'uxic against chuxoc noted in unit 13; oquic mt → okik; several Sonnet gloss errors fixed, including an invented example in the chi broadening). Many senses marked inferred/guess (the lots speech, cat choconic / cat taquentah, Cat quix la vloc, the wooden people's lacks, xcut / xcute). Glosser on Sonnet; drafter and both review passes on the routine's model. Seven house renderings added to conventions.md.
